claims.summary: Over a field, for R=k[x], the old degree-D' closure J and rho:R->Mat_k(R) given by commuting rho(x_i) of entry degree <=T, a repair nu in R^k with R acting through rho (soundness on axiom multiples within D-K, killing rho(wE_i)nu in J^k with deg(wE_i)<=D-K, survival rho(w)nu not in J^k, T(D-K)+deg nu<=D') is certified by a matrix coefficient e_l^T rho(g) nu; a change of basis P in GL_k(R) of degree p diagonalizing rho into substitutions gives a substitution repair of degree <=deg nu+p; and if only x_1 is twisted (rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>=2) and x_1^2-x_1 is an axiom, with D-K>=2 and room T(D-K)+T+deg nu<=D', then with u_1=rho(x_1)nu, u_0=nu-u_1, rho(g)nu is congruent to g|_{x_1=1}u_1+g|_{x_1=0}u_0 and every repair yields a substitution repair by x_1->1 or x_1->0 with a coordinate of u_1 or u_0; the triangular twist [[x_1,q],[0,0]] (split into x_1->0 or the scalar nu_1+q nu_2) and the quadratic twist [[0,x_2],[1,0]] (split into x_1->1 or x_1->x_2) are instances.
claims.assessment: Working proof after a failed first draft: the sole fresh-context medium reviewer refuted a two-term class, supplied the split arguments and the per-variable lemma, and checked the rewrites in follow-ups (review record in research/results/common_multiplier_twisted_module_20261016).
claims.rationale: Shows that matrix repairs twisting one Boolean variable add nothing beyond substitution repairs; leaves twists of several variables at tight room.
claims.next_action: The two-variable twist at room below 2T, n=2, k=2: whether a repair there stays unsplit.
